## What changed

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes, or this change cannot affect browser behaviour
- [ ] Tests specify the new behaviour rather than restating the implementation
- [ ] Prince notation (`x`, `z`, `h`, `y`, `theta`, `phi`) is used consistently
- [ ] No hard-coded hidden-layer width or depth
- [ ] Dependency direction unchanged, or the architecture rules were updated
      deliberately
- [ ] Screenshots attached if visual behaviour changed
